section_1_background.narrative: Late shipments on key account orders have risen above the True North target of 95% on-time.
section_1_background.business_impact: Margin erosion via expedited freight and customer goodwill cost.
section_1_background.constraint_created: Project Design backlog cascades into Operations sequencing.

section_2_current_condition.narrative: Orders are entering Project Design without complete measurement packets, requiring rework before metal can be cut.
section_2_current_condition.process_observation: Sales hands off; PD opens packet; finds gaps; emails customer; waits 3 to 5 days for response.

section_3_goal_target.value_expected: Recover ~$120K/yr in expedited freight; lift CSAT.

section_4_root_cause.problem_statement: Key-account orders miss True North on-time because PD waits on customer-supplied measurements after handoff.

five_whys.why: Why are we late? Because metal cut is delayed.
Why is metal cut delayed? Because PD has not released the packet.
Why has PD not released? Because measurements are missing.
Why are measurements missing at handoff? Because Sales does not collect them at the order stage.
Why does Sales not collect them? Because the order entry checklist does not require measurements as a gate.

section_4_root_cause.root_cause_confirmed_by: 12-order audit; 11 of 12 had no measurements at PD handoff.
root_causes_identified: Order-entry checklist does not gate on measurements.
No standard customer-side measurement template handed to Sales.

actions.action: Add measurements gate to order-entry checklist
actions.detail_rationale: Hard-stop in HubSpot deal stage; cannot advance without uploaded measurement file.
actions.addresses_root_cause: Order-entry checklist does not gate on measurements

section_6_effect_confirmation.key_insight: Most of the projected gain comes from removing the customer-roundtrip wait, not from PD speed.

actions.item: Re-audit 12 key-account orders 60 days after rollout

section_7_follow_up.standardize_next_steps: If gains hold, roll out the measurements gate to all order types in Q4.
